title: Nigel Dawn - Secondaries in Private Markets (EP.378)

reader_summary.headline: Nigel Dawn is the global head of Private Capital Advisory at Evercore.
reader_summary.overview: Nigel Dawn is the global head of Private Capital Advisory at Evercore, where he leads the secondaries business he started a decade ago. Under Nigel's leadership, Evercore had become the market leader in transaction volume and is involved in approximately 30-40% of all secondaries market activity . Our conversation covers Nigel's observations on the growing secondaries market, including its history, rationale for LPs and GPs, incentives, critiques, other liquidity options.
